event.title: Baddies & Bosses Concert
event.description: Baddies & Bosses Live in Concert brings a major night of hip-hop energy to Municipal Auditorium on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Presented by STASHHOUSE KD, this one-night-only concert features a stacked lineup with BossMan Dlow, Plies, Kash Doll, Skilla Baby, KenTheMan and Kalii all performing live on one stage. Fans can expect a high-energy evening packed with big performances, crowd favorites and nonstop entertainment in the heart of downtown Kansas City. Grab your crew, get your fit together and be in the building for one of the city’s can’t-miss concert events of the year.

event.description: KC Pet Fest is Kansas City’s premier pet festival and pet expo, created for pets and the people who love them. We bring together local pet businesses, national pet brands, animal organizations, and thousands of pet lovers for one unforgettable, family-friendly event in Kansas City. More than a traditional pet expo, KC Pet Fest is an interactive festival experience designed to celebrate all pets — dogs, cats, reptiles, small animals, and more. Attendees can explore curated pet vendors, live demonstrations, educational sessions, adoption opportunities, entertainment, and hands-on activities built specifically for pet owners. Founded in Kansas City, our mission is to create the Midwest’s most dynamic pet event that connects the local pet community, supports small businesses, and elevates the way our city celebrates our animals.

event.title: NCAA Div. II Women’s Volleyball Championship
event.description: The NCAA Division II Women’s Volleyball Championship comes to Municipal Auditorium in Kansas City, Missouri, December 3–5, 2026. The championship will showcase top Division II women’s volleyball programs competing in a single-elimination tournament to determine the national champion. Hosted as part of the 2026 NCAA Division II Fall Festival, the event joins a slate of national championships taking place across the Kansas City region and welcoming more than 900 student-athletes. Volleyball fans can experience championship-level competition inside Municipal Auditorium, an iconic Art Deco-style arena in the heart of downtown Kansas City.
